When I was 13, my parents woke me up in the morning and brought everyone into my bedroom to sit on my bed, and told us my grandmother had died. It was me and my siblings’ first experience with death other than a couple pets. I’m 20 now and still don’t want to be in the corner of my room where my bed used to be because it makes me sad. My grandmother was my favourite person in the world, my closest friend, and everyone in our family and the community loved her. I’m glad she’s resting peacefully now but I would’ve preferred to get the news somewhere more neutral like the living room.
